name: flux
description: Renamed to rheon: run `flux install rheon`.
author: takakix2
notes: The package manager is now called rheon (flux-tools #48): `flux` is also Flux CD's CLI, which installs into the same ~/.local/bin. This entry carries the same binary so an old install can update; run as `flux`, it says so every time. `flux install rheon` installs the new name and removes this one (only when the declaration is ours).
